mission.goal: Deliver a commercially hardened Windows Federation execution plane with hosted runtime proof and a safe owner-workstation adapter.
mission.workflow: typed task -> policy gate -> Windows execution -> hash-bound receipt -> artifact -> semantic readback
mission.data: privacy-minimized task envelope, bounded result and receipt; no secrets or raw private evidence
mission.interface: Python CLI, PowerShell entrypoint, GitHub Actions workflow
mission.environment: GitHub-hosted windows-latest; optional separately bound Windows 11 workstation
mission.governance: FUSE parent; N-OMEGA continuation; Formation/SOVARA/FDOF authority; SOL 6.2 recovery; ProofOS/RealityGuard proof
mission.testing: unit, source integration, Windows hosted smoke, permission and path boundary tests
mission.deployment: FDOF-fenced GitHub PR followed by Windows workflow job and artifact readback
mission.continuity: receipt identity, source SHA, correlation ID, bounded task TTL, idempotent read-only effects and handoff files

assumptions.stack: Python standard library plus PowerShell 7; no runtime package dependencies
assumptions.runtime: GitHub-hosted Windows is the deployable baseline; owner-workstation binding remains a separate authority event
assumptions.storage: JSON receipts are bounded workflow artifacts retained for seven days
assumptions.authentication: GitHub workflow identity is sufficient for the hosted read-only plane; Google Cloud must use OIDC/WIF if later added
assumptions.deployment: The repository admits changes through an FDOF-fenced pull request and proves them on windows-latest

components.database: NOT_APPLICABLE: receipts are immutable workflow artifacts
components.worker: GitHub-hosted Windows runner or separately bound Windows host
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: owner/event invocation only; no new recurring scheduler
components.storage: bounded JSON receipt artifact retained seven days
components.authentication: GitHub dispatch/PR authorization for the hosted profile; workflow token contents read-only; task issuer is a policy label, not a cryptographic credential

observability.correlation_ids: task_id plus correlation_id plus GitHub run and attempt
observability.health_checks: health task and Windows semantic verification step
observability.structured_logs: JSON CLI output and failure output
observability.audit_logs: GitHub job plus immutable receipt artifact
observability.metrics_alerts: workflow conclusion, duration and receipt fields; alerts remain existing GitHub notifications

testing.e2e_or_smoke: FUSE Windows Execution Plane v1 workflow health task
testing.failure_first: expiry, issuer, effect, unknown task, unknown field, absolute path and path escape

deploy_commands: source-admit through FDOF-fenced pull request; workflow executes on pull_request
rollback_commands: revert the source-admission commit; no persistent provider state exists

continuity.idempotency: read-only operations are idempotent in effect; task and correlation IDs plus TTL bound retries without claiming durable replay prevention
continuity.checkpoints: source SHA, job ID, attempt, artifact ID, task SHA and result SHA
continuity.resume_conditions: fresh main/FDOF plus terminal prior job state
continuity.stop_switch: owner stop, stale mission, FDOF collision, test failure, unexpected effect or receipt mismatch

test_results: 10/10 pre-existing BEF Windows regression tests passed locally on 2026-09-10
proof.semantic_verification: Local semantic checks passed; hosted Windows proof remains required
unresolved_defects: hosted Windows receipt not yet read back
